title: The session UI keeps showing "Authorization is held …" after the server has no retained prompt; a manual refresh clears it
outcome: The session view shows a held-authorization label only while the server actually holds a retained prompt, and clears it without a manual refresh once the server state changes.
acceptance: The cause is classified with evidence: whether the label came from a stale client projection (a missed update) or from the generic fallback being applied to a preview that is not a hold.

The label appears only when the server state holds a retained prompt and clears on the next state update without a manual refresh; a UI test drives a held then released session and asserts the label's appearance and removal, and that a non-hold preview never shows the hold wording.
